This page is hostile on purpose. On load it writes the selected payload into
document.title and console.log. If the tty-safe projection is
missing or wrong, opening this page in a terminal browser will write control bytes into
your terminal. Canaries are echo-only and destroy nothing, but clear your
clipboard first (pbcopy </dev/null) so pbpaste is a clean
oracle afterwards. Select a case with ?case=<id>;
?case=none loads a benign title and applies nothing.
